New Streaming and Theatre Releases Announced for the Week

Several new titles are set to be released on Over-The-Top (OTT) platforms and in theatres this week. Among the announced releases are 'The Revolutionaries', 'Last Man In Tower', 'Haiwaan', 'The Paper', and 'Ghamasaan'. These titles will be available on platforms including Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, and JioHotstar, with release dates spanning from September 7 to September 11, 2026.
